verdict.rationale: Rule backtesting is a fair question for a compliance platform with transaction monitoring, but the evidence never mentions rule simulation, backtesting, or previewing what a rule would have blocked, flagged, or cost against historical data. Configurable risk-score equations, screening configurations, and CSV/date-range exports are adjacent features or user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can backtest a rule against my historical traffic before deploying it, seeing exactly what it would have blocked, flagged, and cost
